environment: Reuse exact warm8 config.environment_exact whitelist; no inherited provider/signing/env credentials or altered HOME/SDK paths. Gradle --offline and sdkDownload=false restrict those acquisitions, without asserting universal OS network isolation.
final_output_preservation: Build/graph failure and original receipt bytes remain preserved. Root copies only completed stable selected AAB and immutable evidence into its new owned packet, proves copy SHA/bytes/CRC and no shared writable inode, then archive reader compares supplied files before/after. No overwrite of active Gradle output or old preparation.
free_space: Reuse existing controller live floor4294967296; root records current physical headroom before admitting selected writes. No fabricated source lease or zero-transient-write attestation.
guard_readbacks: 4 controlled combined invocations: maintained source fence before/after and combined APP/SDK/protected/runtime before/after, 300s each. Preserve finite receipts and failed current observations.
module_loading: Capture exact pinned bytes into modules as warm8 does; wire controller.reader, controller.require_pass, guards.load_metadata and fence.metadata to captured validated modules. Do not invoke run_stage.py with a nonexistent aab stage or mutate its stage choices. Root owns a narrowly reviewed next-stage driver using existing boundary functions.
owned_process_cleanup: start_new_session process group only; original TERM5/KILL5/reap5 plus finite residue observation. Genuine exit0 still fails on residual group, timeout, headroom failure or group-probe refusal; never gradle --stop, pkill/global kill, cache deletion or restoration of protected originals.
run_process: Reuse exact pinned controller.run_process and guards.process_success for each declared command; retain complete exclusive stdout/stderr/process JSON and actual before/after guard records.
source_guards_before_after: fence verify root against actual root-pinned review8 source-fence.json; keep index/identity/selection/excluded upstream QA semantics and record any source drift rather than claiming current maintained-source acceptance
